title: Withdraw
gateBody: We pay out securely through Stripe. Connecting takes under a minute, and your money lands in a bank in {{country}}.
switchBody: Send your withdrawals to a bank in {{country}}?
connectBody: Your withdrawals will go to a bank in {{country}}. You can't change this later.
continueBody: Your Stripe account needs a few last details. It only takes about a minute, then you can withdraw anytime.
